# Upstream parity decisions

Product reference: [`vercel-labs/eve-software-factory-template`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/eve-software-factory-template), pinned at `1cd9fa53543d2ed007baf35fc9d44eb434e43c9c`. This intake compares baseline `6bc5febab95de4c05fa08b164f544650f6aa11aa` with upstream [#13](https://github.com/vercel-labs/eve-software-factory-template/pull/13) and [#15](https://github.com/vercel-labs/eve-software-factory-template/pull/15), not a wholesale tree sync. Thanks @bensabic for the upstream implementation and hardening.

## Integrated behavior

- Exact-host sandbox egress defaults and deployer overrides, applied when root and repository stations open. Credentialed Git transfers remain GitHub-only regardless of station overrides.
- Snapshot tooling preparation, with its content digest in the environment key. Git is checked and pnpm 11.25.0 is installed only when missing. No credential shim or gh lease enters a station.
- Session-scoped npm/pnpm/Yarn install-script suppression before repository setup, with the explicit install-script opt-in and actionable restricted-network setup errors.
- Typed decision-model triage, including routing, vocabulary-only label suggestions, duplicate confidence thresholds, bounded input, and clarification through the classifier. Existing GitHub tools still read evidence and apply labels under their existing policies.
- Typed CI cause diagnosis before revision attempts. Existing `github__getCiFailureContext` provides checks and failed logs; `diagnose_ci_failure` judges supplied, bounded, scrubbed evidence and treats missing logs as unknown. No gh download path or new CI mutation surface is added.
- Bearer-only HTTP ticket submission and caller-bound status reads. Permanent private claims prevent repeat dispatch after session loss or completion, not just within eve's session idempotency window. Input, event reads, response size, and read time are capped.
- No root shell or file writes; repository execution remains in independent stations. The root usage policy retains both output and uncached-input caps.
- Explicit failed/cancelled/empty station results; local-dev info/eval permissions without changing production authentication; channel-only GitHub credentials narrowed to metadata/issue/PR permissions on the configured repository.
- Upstream model assignments, Connect 2.9.3, and Blob 2.9.0. eve 1.0.0 and AI SDK 7.0.173 were already aligned; the lockfile changes only these dependency edges.
- Strict discovery diagnostics, offline regressions in `validate`, and split standalone CI with commit-pinned actions and Node 24/26 test/discovery jobs. The nested workflow does not execute as a monorepo workflow.

## Remaining deltas and boundaries

| Upstream file or feature                                                                                                                                                             | Local boundary and work needed for parity                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `agent/lib/github/{lease,shell,cli,git-cli,shims,hooks,checkout,tools}.ts`, station `tools/bash.ts`, root `tools/bash.ts`, removal of `extensions/github.ts` and checkout/push tools | Upstream leases credentials to live station VMs. Surviving repository processes, hooks, configuration, or replaced executables can use that credential window. Parser/shim guards are not VM isolation. Keep fresh disposable bare-Git transfers, bounded object bundles, literal remotes, clean Git/environment, one validated ref, actual default/protected-branch refusal, and no force push. CLI parity requires a runtime-only command surface backed by those same isolated boundaries, not upstream leases. The root shell and file-write tools are disabled; GitHub commands remain on the gated extension instead of upstream's gh-only bash parser. |
| `agent/lib/github/push-signed.ts` / `FACTORY_SIGNED_COMMITS`                                                                                                                         | Not enabled. Upstream runs commit replay in the credentialed station, permits unbounded Git output/API response sizes and commit/blob work, and changes local SHAs after replay. A safe port must run bounded replay only in a new transfer VM, verify trees and non-force ref updates, return a bounded signed-object bundle to the station, and verify the imported ref against the expected signed SHA before another revision. Do not advertise the opt-in until that round trip is implemented and tested.                                                                                                                                               |
| `agent/channels/github.ts`, `agent/lib/trust.ts`, automatic PR-open summaries                                                                                                        | Preserve API-verified roles, canonical numeric repository identity, same-repository CI heads, and permanent issue claims. Upstream `author_association` stamps and summary-only prompts cannot replace these checks or isolate a factory session's station/storage surface. Summaries remain disabled until a separate capability-limited agent exists.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `agent/channels/linear.ts` and `agent/connections/linear.ts`                                                                                                                         | Keep authenticated member identity and configured workspace binding at intake and each MCP call, including reads. Never substitute a sender name or shared app auth for membership.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `agent/memory/*`, station memory mounts, `agent/lib/memory/{brain,scope}.ts`, removal of preference/brain tools                                                                      | Existing private Markdown documents and principal/repository keys remain authoritative. Upstream file memory uses numbered-entry documents, different namespaces, and different principal key derivation. Deleting the current tools would silently abandon stored notes/preferences. Parity needs an explicit data/ownership migration preserving private access, user separation, bounded documents, autonomous brain-write refusal, and the human clear-preferences gate. The root continues to pass relevant verified brain facts in station handoffs.                                                                                                    |
| `agent/lib/intake/callbacks.ts`, callback fields in `ticket.ts`                                                                                                                      | Callbacks are rejected. Upstream's exact hostname allowlist does not validate DNS-resolved private/reserved destinations; a configured host can become an SSRF destination. Add a vetted outbound-fetch boundary with DNS/IP checks, no redirects, capped bodies/time, and signatures before enabling callbacks.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Intake OIDC/local-dev fallbacks and status payload                                                                                                                                   | The write entrypoint requires its dedicated bearer; general project OIDC/local-dev auth cannot dispatch work here. Status returns bounded summary fields, not raw failures or unbounded event history. The caller is tied to the credential digest, so rotation deliberately changes the address space. A shared bearer is one caller, not tenant isolation. Broader auth requires explicit submitter/resource authorization.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `agent/instrumentation/otel.ts` (`recordContent` for every audience)                                                                                                                 | Not copied. Automatically tracing all private-repository conversation content creates a second disclosure/storage surface. Keep eve's audience-aware trace defaults; operators must explicitly choose any content-recording policy.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Upstream tests, Vitest migration, broad public-tool/schema harness                                                                                                                   | Keep the template's standalone Node/tsx runner and focused owner-boundary regressions. No multi-thousand-test inventory, broad test-only injection seams, or source-string copies are imported. Routing evals follow typed triage, but live model/sandbox/build/eval behavior still needs a scratch deployment.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

The upstream product behavior remains the reference for future work. Each remaining delta should close through a safe adapter or an explicit migration, not by weakening the boundaries above.
